about.title: A bit about who I am
about.p1: I'm an advanced student of the Information Systems degree at UNNE (4th year), with an academic GPA of 8.17. I'm passionate about programming and constantly learning new technologies.
about.p2: I have solid knowledge of object-oriented programming, algorithms and data structures, databases and software engineering. I work with Python, SQL, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, using Git and GitHub daily.
about.p3: I completed a Data Analyst Bootcamp at Devlights, where I deepened my skills in data analysis with Python, SQL queries and visualization. I'm currently pursuing the AWS Certified AI Practitioner certification, focused on AI and Machine Learning fundamentals.
about.p4: I'm looking to join a technology team where I can apply my knowledge, gain professional experience and contribute to quality software solutions.
